snippet.title: Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers – Demo Walkthrough (Secrets & Hidden Keys)
snippet.description:
Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers – Demo Walkthrough (Secrets & Hidden Keys) In the early 1900s, off the coast of Scotland, the Eilean Mor lighthouse has gone silent.

The light is out. The three keepers have vanished. As a reserve keeper, you are sent to investigate… but beware you may become the fourth to disappear.

⚡ In this demo gameplay video, we explore the dark mystery of the island:

- Searching the lighthouse rooms

- Finding hidden keys and notes

- Uncovering secrets of the missing keepers

- Experiencing the terrifying atmosphere powered by Unreal Engine 5

🎮 Coming soon to PlayStation, Steam, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.
